claims: The 98th Academy Awards were held on March 15, 2026.
Jessie Buckley won Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards for Hamnet.
Rose Byrne was nominated for Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards for If I Had Legs I'd Kick You.
Kate Hudson was nominated for Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards for Song Sung Blue.
Renate Reinsve was nominated for Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards for Sentimental Value.
Emma Stone was nominated for Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards for Bugonia.
Jessie Buckley performed as Agnes in Hamnet.
Hamnet was directed by Chloé Zhao.
Bugonia was directed by Yorgos Lanthimos.
Song Sung Blue is a film based on the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel
